requirement_match.summary: Full user-authorized integration from main plus reviewed WIP and two feature commits; caches/credentials excluded; version and notes3.2.0.

security.summary: Main strict auth/atomic rate limits/security overrides preserved; global alias keeps quotas; moderation private projections/verified identity/media/revocation tested. Private retention disclosure corrected.

code_quality.summary: Lint/typecheck199 unit tests and isolated production build pass;11 opt-in transaction tests separately pass; browser and Lighthouse evidence bounded.

failure_paths.summary: Offline recovery, stale session, cancellation, invalid identity, denied access, concurrent publication/reputation/counters and no-JS covered.

error_handling.summary: Session timeout/outage distinct from anonymous; related failures preserve reading; safe network messages; known fixture/setup failures resolved without weakening production controls.

production_readiness.summary: Existing Firebase runtime/secret reference/no-emulator preflight passes; current flags preserved; source release/rollout explicit human authority; immutable prior revision recorded. Live publication verification remains after deployment.

trade_offs.summary: Streamed missing pages can be200/noindex; no private content exposed. No-JS styling reduced; bounded heuristics do not guarantee spam detection; no field performance or live OAuth certification.

findings.resolution: Alias retains identical atomic budgets; unit/emulator/preflight pass.

findings.resolution: Current semantic controls/status scopes, isolated demo hosts/blob directory, fail-closed noindex checks and real CMS rerun.
